item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:50 HKT 18/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it will remain rather cool this morning over the coast of southern China. It will be cold over some inland areas, where the temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. With the northeast monsoon moderating slightly early next week, daytime temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas midweek next week. It will be cloudier and windy over the region. The easterly airstream will weaken slightly in the latter part of next week. It will be brighter over Guangdong and mild during the day. A surge of the northeast monsoon will affect southern China during next weekend.
